title: ShieldCare Late Fee Escalation Schedule
content:
## Rates of escalation

The rate at which a late fee is billed on a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan rises where the
arrears is long and where the plan has been in this position before. Two things are read: how many
periods the arrears covers, and whether a late fee already stands billed on the plan inside the
last 12 months.

| The plan's position | The rate at which the fee is billed |
| --- | --- |
| the arrears covers more than 3 periods, and a fee already stands billed on the plan inside the last 12 months | 150 percent |
| the arrears covers more than 3 periods, and no fee stands billed on the plan inside the last 12 months | 125 percent |
| every other plan | the plain rate of 100 percent |

## Both sides of the period threshold

"More than 3 periods" means 4 periods or more: an arrears covering exactly 3 periods is not above
the threshold and is billed at the plain rate of 100 percent, whatever the plan's fee history. An
arrears covering 4 periods is above it, and the fee history then separates 150 percent from 125
percent.

## The combinations set out

| Periods the arrears covers | A fee billed inside the last 12 months | Rate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | no | 100 percent |
| 3 | yes | 100 percent |
| 6 | no | 125 percent |
| 5 | yes | 150 percent |
| 6 | yes | 150 percent |
